questions.stem: Find the depression in freezing point (in K) of a $0.1\ \text{molal}$ aqueous solution of $\text{NaCl}$, assuming complete dissociation. ($K_f$ of water $= 1.86\ \text{K kg mol}^{-1}$). Give your answer to three decimal places.
questions.solution:
**Key idea:** $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, and NaCl gives 2 ions ($i = 2$).

$\Delta T_f = 2 \times 1.86 \times 0.1 =$ **$0.372\ \text{K}$**
hints: What is the van't Hoff factor for NaCl?
